Did you know?

You get just 3:36 per question.

100 questions across two 3-hour, 50-question sessions. Train to average ~3:00 and you bank ~30 minutes to revisit the ones you flagged.

USPTO exam format · watch the clock spin as you scroll ⏱

Self-testing makes 61% stick a week later.

Quizzing yourself beats rereading (just 40%) — about 50% better retention. Flashcards are exactly that retrieval loop, so you're already on the highest-yield method.

Roediger & Karpicke, Psychological Science (2006)

You need 70% to pass — most don't.

Only about 49% of test-takers cleared it in 2024 (up from 46%). Steady retrieval practice is how the half who pass get there — aim every set at 70%+.

Wysebridge 2024 USPTO Patent Bar Year-in-Review

About 180 hrs over ~12 weeks gets you ready.

Roughly 2 hours a day. Spacing short sessions across days is one of the two most effective study strategies ever measured — keep coming back a little at a time.

Hattie & Donoghue (242 studies); Wysebridge 12-week plan
